side_kinds:
Emotion-state welds as a DECLARED reading table (DERIVED), plus candidate dealing.
Side kinds:
  claim        functional assignment of the glyph to a referent (competes)
  split        a sensor's later, secondary glyph; the sensor already holds an earlier primary glyph
  same         same referent as the holder (stays)
  label        label-only record (PR #49 NOT_INTERPRETABLE); not compared, no reading forced
  suggestion   listed in suggested_glyphs / decoration; not an assignment
Rule (PROPOSED, not decided here): the earliest dated CLAIM holds; every other claim and every split moves.
Exception: the balance weld, fixed by field report (Rosetta usage holds).
candidate_rule: single code point; Geometric Shapes (U+25A0-25FF) and Miscellaneous Technical (U+2300-23FF) first, then Mathematical Operators; emoji-presentation and bracket/line pieces excluded; absent as literal, \\uXXXX, &#x..; and U+XXXX from every tracked file of RSC, FCC, GTB, MC, PI, EaS, ACS.
